identity.name: 7 Windows GMT
identity.one_liner: Minase's hand-made 41mm case with seven sapphire windows in the side that show the movement — a small atelier in Akita, Japan, with a five-axis CNC case and a hand-finished movement.

provenance_events.description: Minase releases the 7 Windows in Akita, Japan — a 41mm steel case with seven sapphire windows in the sides that show the hand-finished movement.

narrative.story: Minase is a small atelier in Akita, Japan, run by Yoshihiro Satoh. The 7 Windows is their most-photographed piece: a 41mm steel case with seven sapphire windows in the sides that show the hand-finished movement.
narrative.collector_notes: The case is milled from a single block of steel using a five-axis CNC — the angular cuts at the lugs are not stamped or moulded but milled.
